Alongside the ongoing 25% price drop on AirPods Pro 3 and $120 off AirPods Max 2 from last week, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch is headlined by Amazon dropping the price on AirTag 2 even lower to a new all-time low with the 4-pack now at $80 ($20 each). We also have Apple’s 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro at $320 off and this 2TB M5 Pro at $500 off, just be sure to scope out Anker’s new SmartTrack Find My wallet card at the $25 Amazon all-time low, and LG’s 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor undercutting the Apple Studio Display XDR by a massive $2,200 (all-time low). Head below for a closer look.

Latest AirPods Pro 3 still down at 25% off, next-gen set not expected until 2027

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)

Hello! AirTag 2 just dropped even lower again, 4-pack now at $80 all-time low ($20 each)

Okay here we go folks: Amazon is now serving up the very best price we have ever tracked on the 4-pack of Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 – you can now land them at $20 each.

Amazon is now offering the 4-pack of AirTag 2 down at $79.99 shipped.

We were tracking this official bundle at $89.99 all of last week, before Amazon dropped the price again yesterday to $85, and now it is even lower to start the week. Regularly $99, this is just shy of 20% off and, while that might not seem like a ton, a particularly notable discount for the latest AirTag 2.

We are looking at just $20 per AirTag in this bundle and the lowest price we have ever seen since release earlier this year.

The single AirTag 2 listing is still sitting at the $24 Prime shipped low we spotted last week, but the 4-pack has dropped even lower (again).

The $20 per Tag price here is on par with the best open-box deal we spotted at Best Buy last week, for the record.

Apple’s 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro is $320 off today, 2TB M5 Pro $500 off

Alongside some ongoing deals on AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off and AirTag 2 now at the best price we have tracked to date, we are also heading into this week with some notable deals on the latest MacBook Pro lineup. Amazon still has the 2TB M5 Pro at $500 off, and we just spotted a chance to score this much more affordable M5 MacBook Pro 24GB model at $320 off. Details below.

If you’re eyeing the more powerful M5 Pro, this model at $500 off via Amazon should certainly be on your radar. But if the less expensive M5 is the move, B&H has a compelling offering on the 14-inch 24GB/1TB config:

B&H is once again offering Apple’s 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 1TB internal storage capacity down at $1,899 shipped.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook proro 24GB/1TB $1,899 (Reg. $2,219)
  • Incl. upgrade 96W Apple Power Adapter

This is a regularly $2,199 machine, but B&H is also throwing in the official 96W Apple Power Adapter – this would run you an extra $20 when configuring this machine on the Apple site.

Amazon is currently charging $2,049 for this same MacBook Pro config, and that one includes the standard 70W charger.

All-in, this B&H offer leaves you with $320 in savings, a deal on par with our previous mention, and a much better price than Amazon at the moment.

As mentioned above, Amazon does, however, have a seriously notable price still rolling on the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB down at $2,699 – that’s $500 off the regular $3,199 list price and a deal that’s not likely to last for much longer.

Anker’s new SmartTrack Find My wallet card for iOS or Android drops to $25 Amazon all-time low

Anker recently released a brand new SmartTrack Find My Card for you wallet – its first to support both Apple’s tracking platform and Google Find Hub – and it has now dropped to a new Amazon all-time low at $25 Prime shipped.

It first landed on Amazon at $35 last month and after a light $5 price drop hit later that month, it is now seeing its first notable price drop to deliver a new Amazon all-time low.

You’re looking at nearly 30% off here and a price on par with some of the better deals we have tracked on comparable wallet tracker cards this year.

I’m personally a big fan of the Nomad Tracking Cards – they start at $35 and go up to $45 for the Pro model with 16 months of battery life before it needs a recharge – but no matter which you go with, I think everyone should have one of these things in their wallet or card carrier. I never leave the house without one.

The latest SmartTrack Card E40 from the Anker brand delivers on all of the most important features, including the wireless charging, while also working on either Apple’s Find My platform or Google Find Hub. It measures out at 1.7 mm in thickness and rings out at up to 80 dB to help track it down when you’re nearby – it, of course, loads right up into the Find My and Find Hub apps as well to see its location on the map.

Clean up your desk with Anker’s clever clamp-on power strip, now down to just $58

LG’s 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor hits lowest price to undercut Studio Display XDR by a massive $2,200

We just spotted a deal at B&H that drops LG’s 32-inch UltraFine evo 6K monitor to $1,099.99 shipped. This display originally launched at $2,000 and has fetched as much as $1,597 in recent months. Today’s deal essentially matches the all-time low that first landed – and is still live – at Amazon earlier this month. LG is also matching the $1,100 price today, giving you plenty of options if stock runs dry at one retailer. At this price, the UltraFine evo 6K also undercuts Apple’s displays by a huge margin. The Studio Display XDR starts at $3,299, making LG’s 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor roughly $2,200 cheaper. Even the standard Studio Display starts at $1,549, so you’re still saving about $500 while getting a larger 32-inch 6K panel. Head below for more details.

LG’s 32-inch UltraFine evo 6K is a high-end workstation monitor aimed at creators who want a large, sharp display without stepping up to Apple’s pricier options. Its 6144 x 3456 panel packs more than 21 million pixels at 224 PPI, giving you plenty of space for editing timelines, full-resolution content, tools, and multiple windows. It also covers 99.5% of the Adobe RGB color space and supports VESA DisplayHDR 600 for better highlights and contrast. This display also has a strong set of connectivity options, with Thunderbolt 5, DisplayPort 2.1, HDMI, and USB-C all included. Mac users also get LG’s Studio Mode with calibrated color presets for more consistent creative work. Overall, it’s a feature-packed 6K option for anyone who wants serious screen real estate without paying Apple display prices.

Woot is also running some solid deals on more affordable Samsung workstation monitors if you don’t want to spend over $1,000 on a new display. A bunch of the brand’s M-series and other budget-friendly models are discounted right now, with prices starting at just $118.

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • This ultra-thin UGREEN wallet tracker works with iPhone and Android, and it’s down to just $20 today (All-time low)
  • This tiny UGREEN ultra-slim 45W Nexode Air charger is the thinnest one in my EDC, and it’s just $27 today
  • Twelve South’s AirFly Pro Wireless Audio Transmitter drops to $40 at Amazon (Black or white)
  • Chipolo Google Find Hub wallet CARD with super button/remote camera shutter now down at $33
  • UGREEN’s MagFlow 25W Qi2.2 car charger returns to $28 (Reg. $40)
  • Acer’s metal MagSafe golf cart mount plunges to $20 Prime shipped

Latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits Amazon all-time low at nearly 30% off (Wired model also on sale)

As part of its late summer deals on a range of Fire tablets, Fire TVs, and Blink smart home gear, Amazon is also now delivering its best price ever on the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro and bringing back Prime Day all-time low pricing on the wired model, both at nearly 30% off the list price.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (Reg. $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (Reg. $250)

While the brand has since released a more affordable Ring Peephole Cam 2K at $100, today we are featuring some particularly notable deals on its latest Pro-grade 4K models.

The Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro is now back down at the Prime Day all-time low for the first time since the late June sale event. This is, in fact, only the second time we have ever tracked this model dropping under $200.

The wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro is now seeing its very first price drop and a subsequent all-time low down at the same $180.

As seen above, both models carry a $250 list price and are now just shy of 30% off for the best deals we can find, and the lowest price we have seen to date.

Both largely the same, boasting up to 10x Enhanced Zoom, night vision, and Retinal 4K with wide-angle video to keep a closer eye on your porch, the wireless model features a Quick Release Ultra Battery Pack for re-charging and an arguably easier installation process (no wiring required), while the Wired model delivers “nonstop power for nonstop protection.”

Scope out our launch coverage from last September for more details.

Best Buy launches new tech deals, NFL Sunday Ticket promo, pre-season TV deals

Amazon now has AirPods Max 2 in all five colors at $120 off (One of the best prices ever)

This week’s giant 60th Anniversary sale is ushering in one of the best prices to date on Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2, and Amazon now has all five colors at $120 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s AirPods Max 2 down at $429 shipped.

Carrying the same $549 as the previous-generation set, you’re looking at a solid $120 in savings here to deliver the best price we can find right now in brand new condition from a reputable retailer.

Best Buy does have the Midnight black set down at $403.99 shipped in “excellent” open-box condition, and that is a lower price, but perhaps not quite enough lower to side-step a brand new set.

Apple unleashed a proper next-generation set of AirPods Max this year, as opposed to just a fresh coat of paint and the USB-C jack on the previous release. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, it is not going to update is over-ear options as part of next month’s new releases, so we are looking at $120 off what could be the latest and greatest Apple over-ears for some time here this week.

There has only been one other sale event to offer them for less, and that was Prime Day earlier this summer that had them selling for $30 under the deal price we have here today – stock was also rather limited and unreliable during the 4-day sale as well.

Amazon has this 512GB iPad mini at $450 under the new list price (Renewed Premium)

While we just started to see some deals landing on iPad Air this week, discounts on iPad in general have been somewhere between weak and non-existent as of late. That said, we did just spot Amazon offering a 512GB iPad mini at a giant $450 off the new list price in its top quality Renewed Premium condition.

Amazon is now offering the 512GB iPad mini A17 – the latest model – down at $449 shipped right now.

This is now an $899 iPad from Apple in new condition you can land right now straight from Amazon at $450 less than that.

It is also worth mentioning that, even before the price hike took hold, we had never seen this model drop below $679 in new condition at Amazon.

As a quick reminder, an Amazon Renewed Premium unit is not the same as a standard renewed listing, or even an “excellent” condition refurb. It, instead, ships with the following:

  • Screen: When present, no scratches.
  • Body: No signs of cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, and other) are visible when the product is held 12 inches away.
  • Battery: When included, batteries have a capacity that exceeds 90% of the original battery life.
  • Accessories: Generic or original equipment manufacturer accessories and packaging provided.
  • Guarantee: Renewed Premium items come with a 365-day return period.

Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro units are $220 off today (Matching Prime Day deal)

While the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is my go-to recommendation for landing deals on iPhone, Apple does not sell its latest iPhone 17 Pro models there yet, and it looks like it won’t until after the 18 series lands next month. Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed listings have now returned to Prime Day pricing at up to $220 off the new list prices.

Amazon’s top-quality Premium Renewed units have been the best option for landing deals on unlocked iPhone 17 Pro units thus far. Not only are you saving hundreds, but you’re also landing the 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life” – the not “premium” renewed and refurbished listings on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty and you won’t get the same battery life grate either.

Right now you’ll find the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models live again at up to $220 off – the 512GB is now $20 less than our previous mention as well:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)

As detailed in yesterday top picks from the Apple refurb store feature, you can land a perfectly capable iPhone 16 model with a 1-year Apple warranty starting from $699 and a 1TB 16 Pro Max at $1,269 – $330 less than the comparable 17 Pro Max, and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (Up to $330 less than series 17)
